description: This file contains unit tests for Deep Links Security in the OpenClawKit app, focusing on validating URL parsing and deep link handling for secure and insecure connection parameters.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that non-loopback WebSocket URLs are rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Ensures URLs with bypass host prefixes are rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Checks that loopback WebSocket URLs are allowed.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Validates rejection of non-loopback setup code URLs.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Ensures setup code URLs with bypass host prefixes are rejected.

methods.name: setupCodeAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Verifies that setup codes with loopback WebSocket URLs are accepted.
